notes.title: Beta Bugs fixed
notes.content:
Some bugs have been fixed : 
- Wrong route leading to the french version instead of the english one (and the other way around).
- New dialogs graphics.
- Assignments outcome fixed.

Beta testers : make sure you update the game.
